verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say users can 'set up automation rules' so mail is handled automatically, which is a first-party background automation capability. It is a single marketing line with no detail on triggers, actions, or scope. The Zapier connection and the API are third-party or developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of which rule triggers and actions exist, evidence that rules run unattended on incoming mail, rule management details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
